title: SharpCap Frame Drop Rate During Capture
dataSources: Observatory environment (`observatory:env`), sky-quality meter (`skyquality:reading`), imaging sessions (`imaging:session`), telescope mount (`mount:status`), cloud sensor (`allsky:cloud`).
app: Backyard observatory automation — roll-off-roof/dome controller, sky-quality meter, cloud sensor, telescope mount, and astrophotography software (N.I.N.A./Ekos) — via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sharpcap:capture dropped_frames>0
eval drop_pct=100*dropped_frames/frame_count
where drop_pct>5
description: Measures SharpCap dropped-frame percentage per capture run.
value: Surfacing sharpcap frame drop rate during capture helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant backyard astronomy & observatory export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It treats when sharpcap frame drop rate during capture matters for your routine.
